name: Gabbi's Mexican Kitchen
tagline: Masterful artisanal regional Mexican gastronomy in historic Old Towne
description: A culinary gem nationally praised by the Michelin Guide and food critics. Chef Gabbi Patrick blends traditional pre-Hispanic and colonial Mexican recipes with modern culinary precision: house-ground corn tortillas, slow-simmered Oaxacan moles, fresh Baja yellowtail crudos, and an extraordinary artisanal tequila and mezcal bar.
historicNote: Located in a landmark 1902 brick structure with original rustic timber ceilings, intimate arched entryways, and soft candlelit romance.

specials.title: Artisanal Taco & Tequila Showcase
specials.description: Tasting flight of 3 handcrafted tacos (Duck Carnitas, Cochinita Pibil, Wild Mushroom) + house reposado margarita for $24.

specials.title: Oaxacan Mole Midweek Feature
specials.description: Chef’s seasonal Mole Negro or Mole Poblano served over Jidori chicken breast with warm organic blue corn tortillas.

specials.title: Mezcaleria Tasting Hour
specials.description: Guided 3-pour artisanal small-batch Mezcal flight with orange slices and sal de gusano for $18.

specials.title: Baja Coastal Ceviche Feature
specials.description: Daily fresh catch yellowtail ceviche with serrano, lime, avocado, and house heirloom tostadas.

specials.title: Weekend Cantina Brunch
specials.description: Chilaquiles Divorciados, Huevos Rancheros con Asada, and blood orange mimosas.

specials.title: Sunday Sunset Sangria
specials.description: House-made hibiscus pomegranate white and red sangrias by the carafe ($26 carafe).

events.title: Masterclass: The Agave Spirits of Oaxaca
events.description: An intimate evening of tasting rare wild agave mezcals with pairings prepared by Chef Gabbi Patrick.

researchMetadata.verificationNotes: Michelin recommended regional Mexican dining; Tuesday agave flights and mole features verified.
